title.en: Fable 18 — The Old Man and Death

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: An old man carried heavy wood along the road.

sentences.ar: הוא היה עייף והניח את העצים.
sentences.en: He was tired and put the wood down.
He said: let death come already.

sentences.ar: הזקן אמר: רק תרים לי את העצים.
sentences.en: The old man said: just lift the wood for me.

sentences.ar: אנשים מבקשים מה שהם לא רוצים.
sentences.en: People ask for what they do not want.
